body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. integrations/pi-protected: (1) the event.willRetry branch is dead code; (2) the image-resize hook rejects instead of resolving null when resizing is unavailable; (3) the fallback chain can exceed its 2000ms budget; (4) some failure codes are returned that are not listed in CODES; (5) the typebox schema coerces null to 0 for numeric settings.
